measurement: P2 — mechanism E (LoRA) against the baseline, on the form verifier
findings: THE RULED 3 EPOCHS OVERFITS 63 EXAMPLES, and three independent signals agree: val loss bottoms at iter 60 (1.388) and climbs to 1.590 by 189 while train loss falls 1.935 -> 0.179; 七絕 form pass HALVES from 32.0% to a 17.3% mean over three seeds; and Latin-token intrusion TRIPLES from ~27 of 200 to ~85.

THE ITER-60 CHECKPOINT (one epoch) IS NOT DESTRUCTIVE: 七絕 34.0% against the baseline's 32.0%, and Latin intrusion 16 of 200 — BELOW the baseline's 27. The val-loss minimum picked the right checkpoint.

The degradation is far larger than seed noise: the three 3-epoch seeds give 七絕 18/20/14 percent, a 6pp spread, against a 15pp gap to the baseline. Running three seeds is what makes that sentence sayable.
七律 remains the form not to score on: the baseline's own two seeds are 40% and 12%.

Mechanism E did NOT improve form at 3 epochs and did not clearly improve it at 1 epoch either. It is a voice intervention and the form verifier is not where its benefit, if any, should appear — but it CAN do harm there, and at 3 epochs it does.
bounds: The iter-60 arm is ONE SEED. Its 34.0% carries the same +/-6.6pp binomial SE as any other 50-sample rate here, and it should have two more seeds before anything rests on it.
The training split is form-imbalanced: 七律 41, 七絕 13, 五絕 4, 五律 1, unregulated 11, over 63 examples. The 絕 forms are the ones scored and the ones least trained.
The form verifier does not read Latin characters at all — the extractor strips to CJK — so intrusion is counted separately and is NOT part of any pass rate above.
Nothing here is the JUDGE. P2's actual question is discrimination, which is 理's harness on the held-out 33; this is the form half only.
One base, one rank, one learning rate, one LoRA run. No sweep.

CORRECTION_2026-09-15_00:3xZ.so: iter-60 is NOT above the baseline. It is indistinguishable from it at this n, and the point estimate is slightly below (28.7 vs 32.0).
what_survives: 3 epochs is destructive: 17.3% mean against 32.0%, with its own spread only 6.0pp — the gap is far larger than the noise.
iter-60 is much better than 3 epochs: 28.7% against 17.3%.

Latin intrusion is the one claim that is robust in iter-60's favour and it is consistent across ALL THREE seeds: baseline 27/26, 3 epochs 84/79/91, iter-60 16/10/14. One epoch of Chinese poetry REDUCES English-token leakage below the base model.
五絕 tells the same story as 七絕: baseline 34.0, 3 epochs 10.7, iter-60 34.0.

The bound was stated correctly in that block's §7 and the headline was built on the number anyway. A bound under a headline does not protect the headline.

FINAL_2026-09-15.table: 七絕 — baseline 32.7% (spread 2.0pp) · iter-60 28.7% (10.0pp) · 3 epochs 17.3% (6.0pp). 五絕 — baseline 34.0% (0.0pp) · iter-60 34.0% (4.0pp) · 3 epochs 10.7% (4.0pp).
FINAL_2026-09-15.what_P2s_form_half_says: Three epochs on 63 examples HARMS form, on both scored forms and by a margin far larger than the seed spread. One epoch does NOT harm it and does not help it: identical mean to the baseline on 五絕 (34.0 vs 34.0) and slightly below on 七絕 (28.7 vs 32.7, with the widest spread in the table). NEITHER adapter improves form.
FINAL_2026-09-15.the_one_robust_gain: Latin-token intrusion, every seed in the same direction: baseline 27/26/24, 3 epochs 84/79/91, iter-60 16/10/14. One epoch of Chinese poetry reduces English-token leakage BELOW the base model.
FINAL_2026-09-15.the_flip_count_that_proves_理s_rule: The baseline gives 五絕 34.0% on ALL THREE seeds — and between any two of those seeds 16, 20 and 28 of the 50 poems FLIP VERDICT, with ZERO identical generations. A rate reproduced three times over a sample that churns half its outcomes. 'Reproduced exactly' is never a claim about stability; count the flips.
FINAL_2026-09-15.note: Mechanism E is a VOICE intervention and the form verifier is not where its benefit should appear. What this half establishes is the COST side: at 3 epochs the cost is large, at 1 epoch it is nil. Whether the voice moved is the judge's question.
